experiment.name: aligned two-timeframe pullback resumption
experiment.rationale: Pullback resumption inside an established higher-TF trend; H1 raw movement is the largest in the ladder.

experiment.name: low-ATR squeeze then range breakout
experiment.rationale: Contracted volatility followed by a breakout tests the 'squeeze pop' direction; Phases 3/4 never combined the two.

experiment.hypothesis: G - momentum following unusually large candles
experiment.name: single large-body candle momentum
experiment.rationale: Event-based momentum (Phases 1/3 used window momentum); M15 gives many events and cost-plausible 1h/3h holds.

experiment.name: H1/H4 trend-sign confluence
experiment.rationale: Confluence of short and long timeframe trend; genuinely untested dimension at the largest raw-movement scale.

experiment.name: fade extremes gated to the low-ATR regime
experiment.rationale: Phase-1 fade-the-extreme (positive raw) may clear costs once restricted to a range-bound regime; frozen threshold, not swept.
